description: PHASE 4 - Next.js web application with Photographer Dashboard (event creation, analytics) and Guest Portal (selfie capture, face search, native share).
steps: Create apps/web/next.config.js - Next.js config with image domains for R2, env variable passthrough
Create apps/web/tailwind.config.ts - Tailwind config with custom colors for SnapDeliver brand
Create apps/web/postcss.config.js - PostCSS with Tailwind and autoprefixer
Create apps/web/tsconfig.json - Next.js TypeScript config with path aliases
Create apps/web/src/app/layout.tsx - root layout with Tailwind global styles, font loading, metadata
Create apps/web/src/app/page.tsx - landing page with links to dashboard and portal
Create apps/web/src/app/(dashboard)/layout.tsx - dashboard layout with sidebar navigation (Events, Analytics, Settings)
Create apps/web/src/app/(dashboard)/events/page.tsx - event list page with create button, shows all events with status
Create apps/web/src/app/(dashboard)/events/create/page.tsx - event creation form using Zod schema validation (name, date, expiry, pricing tier selector)
Create apps/web/src/app/(dashboard)/events/[id]/page.tsx - single event detail with photo gallery, QR code generation, stats
Create apps/web/src/app/(dashboard)/analytics/page.tsx - analytics dashboard showing QR scans, downloads, shares count per event to prove ROI. Charts/metrics display.
Create apps/web/src/app/(portal)/layout.tsx - mobile-first portal layout, minimal chrome, full viewport
Create apps/web/src/app/(portal)/[eventId]/page.tsx - event portal entry, shows event name and selfie capture prompt
Create apps/web/src/app/(portal)/[eventId]/selfie/page.tsx - selfie capture UI using getUserMedia API. Captures photo from front camera, shows preview, sends to API for face vector extraction.
Create apps/web/src/app/(portal)/[eventId]/results/page.tsx - displays matching photos from pgvector search results in a grid. Each photo card has download button AND native share button.
Create apps/web/src/components/ui/Button.tsx, Card.tsx, Input.tsx, Select.tsx - basic UI primitives with Tailwind
Create apps/web/src/components/dashboard/EventCard.tsx, StatsCard.tsx, QRGenerator.tsx - dashboard-specific components
Create apps/web/src/components/portal/SelfieCapture.tsx - camera capture component with getUserMedia, canvas snapshot, preview/retake flow
Create apps/web/src/components/portal/PhotoGrid.tsx - responsive image grid for search results

Create apps/web/src/components/portal/ShareButton.tsx - implements navigator.share() Web Share API for 1-tap sharing to Instagram/WhatsApp with Social HD watermarked version. Falls back to download if share not supported.
Create apps/web/src/lib/api-client.ts - typed API client wrapping fetch for all API endpoints (events, uploads, face search)
Create apps/web/src/lib/face-search.ts - sends captured selfie to API, receives matching photos array
Create apps/web/src/hooks/useCamera.ts - React hook for getUserMedia camera access with cleanup
Create apps/web/src/hooks/useShare.ts - React hook wrapping navigator.share() with feature detection and fallback
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard has event creation flow with proper form validation using Zod schemas
Analytics page shows QR scans, downloads, and shares metrics
Guest portal is mobile-first with selfie capture using getUserMedia
Selfie is sent to API for vector extraction and pgvector search
ShareButton implements navigator.share() for native sharing to Instagram/WhatsApp
ShareButton falls back to download when Web Share API is not available
All API calls go through typed api-client.ts, no hardcoded URLs
NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL env var used for API base URL
verification: Verify apps/web/src/lib/api-client.ts reads base URL from NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL env var
Verify apps/web/src/app/(dashboard)/analytics/page.tsx shows QR scans, downloads, shares
